body.objective: Decide whether the exact compact-spacetime quadrupole Julia instrument can be realized by a bounded local effect or a normal locally coupled pointer under standard Reeh--Schlieder hypotheses, and identify the nearest local operational escape without promoting the auxiliary BT carrier to a Lorentzian AQFT.
activates: a no-go theorem for nonzero exactly vacuum-dark bounded local effects
an exact bounded-spectral-truncation lift to a balanced local contrast under affiliation and domain hypotheses
body.current_gate: Let M=A(O) and N=A(O') commute and assume N Omega is dense. Prove Omega is separating for M, then apply positive functional calculus to the exact Julia effect P_u/4. Extend the conclusion to normal tensor-pointer dilations by the von Neumann slice map. Record that a balanced difference of two nonzero effects evades the zero-probability premise but is not yet affiliated with the BT quadrupole density.
body.stop_condition: Land a CLASSIFIED LOCAL-ALGEBRAIC certificate, independent verifier, adversarial tests and report proving the scoped local-effect and local-pointer obstruction, with an exact countermodel showing Reeh--Schlieder cyclicity is essential and a bounded-spectral-truncation theorem constructing an exact balanced local contrast conditional on self-adjoint affiliation and domains. Update Papers V and VI without changelog prose.
body.forbid: no claim that the public BT theory already has a positive Haag--Kastler net or the Reeh--Schlieder property; no claim that all local detectors are impossible; no promotion of a balanced finite fixture to a BT detector; no type-III hypothesis inserted when the weaker separating argument suffices; no Eq. 19, gravity, QME or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL promotion; no literature-priority claim
body.resource_hint: If A Omega=0 for A in M, then A B Omega=B A Omega=0 for all B in N; density of N Omega gives A=0. For E positive in M, zero vacuum expectation gives E^(1/2) Omega=0 and hence E=0. The exact E_click=P_u/4 is nonzero and kills the vacuum. A normal local pointer unitary has induced effect (id tensor omega)(U^*(1 tensor Q)U) in M, so it obeys the same theorem. If the local density D is self-adjoint affiliated and Omega,X2,X4 are in Dom(D), the five real response coordinates of D_n=D 1_[minus n,n](D) converge to (0,0,0,Re a,Im a); finite-dimensional span closure gives an exact finite combination, hence a bounded balanced contrast.
